questions.prompt: How many total litres of water are consumed by all residential households in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: Canada has a population of approximately 40 million people
Each person uses roughly 250 litres of water per day at home
40 million people times 250 litres per day equals 10 billion litres per day
10 billion litres per day times 365 days yields approximately 3.5 trillion litres per year

questions.prompt: How many total individual sheets of paper are consumed by all elementary school students in public education across Australia in a single school year?
reasoning: Australia has about 2 million elementary school students
Each student uses an average of 5 sheets of paper per school day
There are roughly 120 school days in a standard academic semester or term block multiplied across the year, yielding about 600 sheets per student annually
2 million students multiplied by 600 sheets per year equals 1.2 billion total sheets

questions.prompt: How many total metres are traversed by the Earth in its orbit around the Sun in a single standard year?
reasoning: The average distance from the Earth to the Sun is approximately 150 million kilometres
The radius of the Earth's orbit is 150 million kilometres, so the orbital circumference is 2 pi times that radius, which is roughly 940 million kilometres

940 million kilometres multiplied by 1000 gives 940 trillion metres
